finding: Property 'hxHref' uses hx-prefix on JS property name. All other components use bare property names (e.g., 'href' on hx-button, hx-link). The hx- prefix belongs on the attribute to avoid collision with native 'href', not the JS property.
suggestion: Rename property to 'href' with attribute 'hx-href' (keep attribute as-is, change JS property name) or document the collision avoidance rationale.

finding: Property 'hxAriaLabel' uses hx-prefix on JS property name. All other components that need accessible labels use 'ariaLabel' (hx-button, hx-combobox, hx-select, etc.) or 'label'. This is the only component with the 'hx' prefix on an aria-related property.
suggestion: Rename property to 'ariaLabel' with attribute remaining 'hx-aria-label' to match the pattern used by hx-button, hx-combobox, hx-select, hx-steps, hx-text-input, and hx-textarea.

finding: Property 'hxSize' uses hx-prefix on JS property name. All other 31 components with a size property use bare 'size' with attribute 'hx-size'. hx-field is the only component where the JS property name also has the prefix.
suggestion: Rename property to 'size' with attribute 'hx-size' to match all other components (hx-button, hx-badge, hx-icon, etc.).

finding: Property 'labelTrigger' uses label-first naming (labelX pattern), but hx-split-button uses 'triggerLabel' (X-label pattern). Library is split: 28 uses of labelX pattern vs 7 uses of xLabel pattern (closeLabel, triggerLabel, menuLabel).
suggestion: Standardize on the dominant labelX pattern. Rename hx-split-button's triggerLabel to labelTrigger and menuLabel to labelMenu. This is a breaking change.

finding: Properties 'triggerLabel' and 'menuLabel' use subject-first naming (xLabel), inconsistent with the dominant labelX pattern used by 28 other properties across the library (labelCopy, labelPrevSlide, labelDropzone, etc.).
suggestion: Rename to 'labelTrigger' and 'labelMenu' to match the dominant pattern. This is a breaking change.

finding: CSS part 'close-btn' uses abbreviated 'btn' while hx-alert, hx-banner, hx-dialog, and hx-toast all use 'close-button'. This is the only component using the abbreviated form.
suggestion: Rename part from 'close-btn' to 'close-button' for consistency with all other closable components. This is a breaking change for consumers using ::part(close-btn).

finding: CSS parts 'prev-btn' and 'next-btn' use abbreviated 'btn'. No other component uses 'btn' abbreviation in part names (hx-button uses 'button', hx-alert/banner/dialog/toast use 'close-button').
suggestion: Rename to 'previous-button' and 'next-button' for consistency. This is a breaking change for consumers using ::part(prev-btn) or ::part(next-btn).

finding: CSS custom properties use '--hx-input-*' prefix instead of '--hx-text-input-*'. Properties like --hx-input-bg, --hx-input-color, --hx-input-border-color are shared with hx-textarea, creating implicit coupling through naming.
suggestion: Either rename to --hx-text-input-* (breaking change) or document that --hx-input-* tokens are intentionally shared across input-type components as semantic tokens.

finding: CSS custom properties use '--hx-input-*' prefix instead of '--hx-textarea-*'. Same tokens as hx-text-input, creating implicit shared styling.
suggestion: Either rename to --hx-textarea-* (breaking change) or document the intentional sharing as semantic-tier tokens.

finding: CSS custom properties use '--hx-tabs-*' prefix instead of '--hx-tab-panel-*' (e.g., --hx-tabs-panel-padding). Breaks the component-token naming convention.
suggestion: Rename to --hx-tab-panel-* or document that tabs sub-components share the --hx-tabs-* namespace by design.

finding: 9 CSS custom properties (--hx-input-*) are documented on both hx-text-input and hx-textarea. These act as semantic-tier tokens but are documented as component-tier. Changing --hx-input-bg affects both components simultaneously.
suggestion: Either promote --hx-input-* to documented semantic tokens (shared input styling tier) or give each component its own namespace.

finding: CSS custom properties '--hx-button-inverted-color' defaults to '#ffffff', '--hx-button-inverted-ghost-hover-bg' defaults to 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)', '--hx-button-inverted-focus-ring-color' defaults to 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'. These bypass the design token system.
suggestion: Use semantic tokens as fallbacks, e.g., var(--hx-color-white, #ffffff) or var(--hx-color-inverted-text, #ffffff).

finding: hx-dialog uses show()/close() methods but emits hx-open/hx-close events. The method names don't match the event names. Drawer uses show()/hide() with hx-show/hx-hide events (consistent).
suggestion: Document intentional deviation (show/showModal align with native HTMLDialogElement API).

finding: Slot 'heading' is used only by hx-card, while hx-dialog and hx-side-nav use slot 'header'. Components with a heading property use the property directly.
suggestion: Evaluate whether 'heading' slot should be renamed to 'header' for consistency, or document the distinction (heading=title text vs header=full header region).

finding: Slot 'action' (singular) is used by hx-banner and hx-toast, while hx-alert, hx-card, hx-structured-list-row, and hx-top-nav use 'actions' (plural). Split between singular and plural.
suggestion: Standardize on 'actions' (plural) which is used by 4 components vs 'action' (singular) by 2.

finding: Slots 'start'/'end' are used by hx-action-bar and hx-split-panel, while 'prefix'/'suffix' are used by 10 components. Two competing patterns for before/after content slots.
suggestion: Document the distinction: 'prefix'/'suffix' for inline adornments within a control, 'start'/'end' for layout regions.

finding: hx-alert uses 'open' property and emits hx-close/hx-after-close events, but has no hx-open event. Other overlay components (dialog, drawer, popover) emit both show/open and hide/close events.
suggestion: Consider adding hx-open event for symmetry, or document that alert open state is declarative-only.

finding: hx-alert has both a 'heading' property AND a 'title' slot. The property is named 'heading' but the slot for the same content is named 'title'. Property/slot name mismatch is confusing.
suggestion: Rename the 'title' slot to 'heading' to match the property name, or rename the property to 'title' to match the slot.

finding: hx-dialog has show() and close() methods (asymmetric: show/close). hx-drawer and hx-toast use symmetric show()/hide() pairs. The dialog.close() aligns with native HTMLDialogElement API.
suggestion: This deviation is justified by alignment with native HTMLDialogElement API. Document the rationale.

finding: CSS part 'input-wrapper' uses '-wrapper' suffix. hx-select uses 'select-wrapper', hx-textarea uses 'textarea-wrapper'. Meanwhile, 31 components use 'base' as their root wrapper part.
suggestion: Document that 'base' is the standard root container part, and '*-wrapper' is used for input-specific containers wrapping native controls.

finding: All 8 CSS custom properties use '--hx-accordion-*' prefix instead of '--hx-accordion-item-*'. Breaks strict component-name-matching convention.
suggestion: Accept as intentional parent-namespace sharing for compound components. Document the pattern.

finding: Multiple CSS properties default to hardcoded rgba values: --hx-color-picker-thumb-border (#fff), --hx-color-picker-thumb-shadow (rgba(0,0,0,0.3)), --hx-color-picker-panel-shadow (rgba(0,0,0,0.15)).
suggestion: Use semantic tokens for shadows and borders where applicable. Some hardcoding may be acceptable for specialized components.

finding: CSS property '--hx-skeleton-shimmer-color' defaults to 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)' — hardcoded value that won't adapt to dark mode.
suggestion: Use a semantic token fallback, e.g., var(--hx-color-shimmer, rgba(255,255,255,0.4)).

finding: Component has 'ariaLabel' property but no 'label' property. Pattern should be documented: use 'label' when visible label is needed, 'ariaLabel' when only screen reader label is needed.
suggestion: Document the accessible labeling strategy across the library.

finding: CSS property '--hx-duration-spinner' uses category-first naming (duration-spinner) instead of component-first (spinner-duration). All other components use component-first naming.
suggestion: Rename to --hx-spinner-duration for consistency with component-first naming convention.

finding: CSS properties '--hx-arrow-size', '--hx-arrow-color', '--hx-auto-size-available-width', '--hx-auto-size-available-height' use generic names without component prefix.
suggestion: Rename to --hx-popup-arrow-size, --hx-popup-arrow-color, --hx-popup-auto-size-available-width, --hx-popup-auto-size-available-height.

finding: Property 'labelSlideOf' is unclear — 'of' is a preposition, making the name read oddly. This labels the 'X of Y' slide indicator text.
suggestion: Consider renaming to 'labelSlideCount' or 'labelSlideIndicator' for clarity.

finding: CSS property '--hx-transition-fast' is a semantic-tier token documented on hx-pagination as a component-tier token. Tier mismatch.
suggestion: Move --hx-transition-fast to semantic token documentation. hx-pagination should document its own component tokens with --hx-transition-fast as fallback.

finding: CSS properties '--hx-font-label-size', '--hx-font-label-weight', '--hx-font-label-line-height', '--hx-font-label-family' use generic category-first naming instead of component-first.
suggestion: Rename to --hx-field-label-font-size, --hx-field-label-font-weight, etc.

finding: CSS property '--hx-touch-target-size' (44px) appears on hx-alert and hx-banner. This is a shared accessibility concern that should be a semantic-tier token.
suggestion: Promote --hx-touch-target-size to the semantic token layer and reference it from both components.

finding: CSS properties '--hx-container-sm' (640px), '--hx-container-md' (768px), '--hx-container-lg' (1024px), '--hx-container-xl' (1280px), '--hx-container-content' (72rem), '--hx-container-narrow' (48rem) default to hardcoded values without semantic token fallbacks.
suggestion: Use semantic breakpoint token fallbacks if available.
